question: I'm a final-year ENTC student with CGPA 8.2. Which research grants can I go for, and by when?
answer:
As a final-year ENTC student with a CGPA of 8.2, you are eligible for several research grants. Please note that you may hold at most two research grants at the same time [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

### Open Grants (Available for Application)
You may apply for the following grants, as your CGPA of 8.2 meets the minimum requirements for each [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].

| Grant Code | Title | Amount | Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| GR-IOT-07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant | ₹80,000 | 20 Jan 2027 |
| GR-5G-15 | 5G and Next-Gen Networks Fellowship | ₹1,10,000 | 31 Jan 2027 |
| GR-VLSI-09 | VLSI Design Research Fellowship | ₹1,20,000 | 10 Feb 2027 |
| GR-SUS-08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | ₹70,000 | 28 Feb 2027 |
| GR-ENT-13 | Student Startup Seed Grant | ₹2,00,000 | 01 Mar 2027 |

*Data source: [SQL]*

### Closed Grants
The following grants are currently closed and are no longer accepting applications [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2]:
*   **GR-HW-06:** Hardware Hackathon Seed Fund (Deadline: 15 Dec 2026) [SQL]
*   **GR-ROB-12:** Autonomous Robotics Research Grant (Deadline: 31 Dec 2026) [SQL]

Ensure you submit your applications before the respective deadlines, as late applications are not considered [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-ENT-13', 'GR-5G-15', 'GR-VLSI-09', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-HW-06', 'GR-IOT-07', 'GR-ROB-12']) ORDER BY application_deadline
